prompt.zh-TW: 比較小山咖啡上個月底和這個月底的資產負債表：現金少了 {{money:vars.amount}}，短期借款也少了 {{money:vars.amount}}，其他項目都沒變，這個月的本期淨利也幾乎是零。最可能發生了哪一類交易？
prompt.en: Compare Hillside Coffee’s balance sheets at the end of last month and this month: cash is down by {{money:vars.amount}}, short-term borrowings are down by {{money:vars.amount}}, nothing else has changed, and this month’s profit is close to nil. What kind of transaction most likely took place?

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。現金和借款同時減少同樣的金額，是還款留下的腳印。
feedback.en: Nice work. Cash and borrowings falling by the same amount at the same time is the footprint of a repayment.

text.zh-TW: 付了一筆店租之類的費用
text.en: An expense such as rent was paid

feedback.zh-TW: 付費用確實會讓現金減少，這點沒錯。不過費用會讓本期淨利跟著下降，也不會讓短期借款變少；這個月的本期淨利幾乎是零，借款卻少了，和付費用對不上。
feedback.en: Paying an expense would indeed reduce cash, that much is right. But an expense also pulls profit down and does nothing to short-term borrowings; here profit was close to nil while borrowings fell, which does not fit an expense.

text.zh-TW: 光看報表上的數字沒辦法判斷
text.en: There is no way to tell from the figures on the statement

feedback.zh-TW: 報表確實不會直接寫出交易的名稱，這點沒錯。不過每一類交易都會在固定的幾個項目留下固定方向的變動，比對這些變動就能倒推出來。
feedback.en: The statement does not name the transaction, that much is right. But each kind of transaction leaves changes of a fixed direction in a fixed set of items, and comparing those changes lets you work backwards to it.

explanation.zh-TW: 從數字倒推交易，看的是「哪幾個項目一起動、往哪個方向動」。{{term:tm_c4sh8k2p}}和{{term:tm_s5b8r3hd}}同時減少同樣的金額、本期淨利幾乎是零，正是{{option:o_ewxr}}的腳印。{{option:o_33gw}}會讓利益下降，也不會讓借款變少；認為{{option:o_fy94}}，則低估了報表能透露的資訊。
explanation.en: Working backwards from figures means asking which items moved together and in which direction. {{term:tm_c4sh8k2p}} and {{term:tm_s5b8r3hd}} falling by the same amount while profit is close to nil is exactly the footprint of {{option:o_ewxr}}. {{option:o_33gw}} would lower profit and leave borrowings untouched, and answering {{option:o_fy94}} underestimates what the statement reveals.
